explained.summary: A checklist for seeing anything clearly. Ask what it actually is in itself, what it’s made of, what gives it its shape and purpose, what role it plays in the world, and how long it will last. Run through these questions and the thing tends to lose its power to dazzle or frighten you.
explained.today: Try it on the new car you’re lusting after, the promotion you’re anxious about or the viral row everyone’s discussing. What is it made of, what is it for, and how long will it really matter?
